_comment: DERIVED (not published by the Vesuvius open-data catalogue). Maps PHerc1203 volume 20260319130212 (2.403um/77keV, 15137x26493x26493) into volume 20250820131727 (9.362um/113keV, 18977x6844x6844). Row order is (x, y, z), matching the transformation_matrix convention used by PHerc0139/0814/1667/Paris4 in the same catalogue, so it can be fed directly to volume-cartographer's vc_transform_geom. Derived 2026-08-17 by trackD/hunt/derive_transform.py + refine_transform.py: level-5 brute-force NCC (0.793, z-flip hypothesis rejected at 0.146) then 15-block level-2/level-4 phase correlation (NCC 0.800-0.886). Residual RMS 22/15/11 um in z/y/x. Cross-checked against the beamline stage coordinates (agrees to 0.27 mm) and visually (volumetric NCC 0.829, trackD/hunt/qc_transform.png).

alternative_similarity_fit._comment: free-scale least squares over the same 15 blocks; scale differs from the nominal pixel-size ratio 2.403/9.362 by 0.024%
